name: Novotel Nha Trang
short_description: A 154-room beachfront hotel on Tran Phu Street directly across from Nha Trang's main beach, with sea-view balconies and a rooftop-adjacent pool and bar.
ai_summary: Novotel Nha Trang sits on Tran Phu Street, the city's main beachfront road, with the beach directly across the street and multiple restaurants, bars, and shops within walking distance. The 154 rooms all feature furnished balconies, many with sea views, alongside The Square buffet restaurant, Le Bar, a pool with city and sea views, and a spa and fitness center. Guests consistently praise the friendly staff, sea views, and central beachfront location, though a subset note noise from nearby beach clubs and nightlife.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Nha Trang on the beach?
faqs.answer: It sits on Tran Phu Street, the city's main beachfront road, with the municipal beach directly across the street, though a private beach area involves extra charges.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Nha Trang have sea-view rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes -- all 154 rooms have furnished balconies, and many face the sea, though the central location can bring some nightlife noise after dark.
